title: A Variational Framework for Nonlinear Chemical Thermodynamics Employing the Maximum Energy Dissipation Principle
summary: The maximum energy dissipation principle is employed to nonlinear chemical thermodynamics in terms of distance variable (generalized displacement) from the global equilibrium, applying the optimal control interpretation to develop a variational formulation. The cost-like functional was chosen to support the suggestion that such a formulation corresponds to the maximum energy dissipation principle.
